title: AI Engineering Intern
description: Build and evaluate small language-model applications with guidance from senior engineers.
experience_requirement: Personal or academic Python projects; no professional experience required.
education_requirement: Currently pursuing or recently completed a technical degree or equivalent learning path.

title: Machine Learning Intern
description: Support data preparation, model experiments, and clear reporting for applied ML projects.
experience_requirement: At least one machine-learning project in a portfolio or coursework.
education_requirement: Undergraduate student or recent graduate in a quantitative field.

title: Generative AI Intern
description: Prototype grounded generative AI features and help maintain evaluation datasets.
experience_requirement: A small generative AI demo or relevant coursework is sufficient.

title: Agentic AI Intern
description: Develop tool-using agent prototypes and test multi-step workflow reliability.
experience_requirement: One year of project experience with LLM applications preferred.
education_requirement: Computer science degree or equivalent practical experience.

title: Python AI Intern
description: Write maintainable Python utilities for data processing and AI service integrations.
experience_requirement: Beginner-friendly; coursework and personal projects are accepted.
education_requirement: Student or recent graduate in any technical discipline.

title: Junior AI Engineer
description: Ship monitored AI-backed API features with an applied engineering team.
experience_requirement: One to two years of software or substantial project experience.
education_requirement: Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent experience.

title: AI Automation Intern
description: Automate internal workflows by connecting Python services to language models and APIs.
experience_requirement: No professional experience required; automation projects are helpful.

title: LLM Engineer Intern
description: Help build retrieval experiments, prompt tests, and lightweight LLM evaluation tools.
experience_requirement: Portfolio projects are accepted in place of work experience.
education_requirement: Current student, recent graduate, or self-taught developer with demonstrable work.

title: Data Science Intern
description: Explore business datasets, create reproducible notebooks, and present useful findings.
experience_requirement: Academic data analysis projects are sufficient.
education_requirement: Pursuing a degree in statistics, engineering, science, or a related area.

title: Applied AI Intern
description: Evaluate computer vision and NLP prototypes against product requirements.
experience_requirement: Two substantial applied ML projects are expected.
education_requirement: Final-year student or graduate in computer science or a related field.
